title: nerv update repairs a stale build or an unloaded service
goal: An up-to-date base whose dist/web is older than the checkout, or whose service is not loaded, is rebuilt and loaded
acceptance: A stale dist/web is rebuilt before the service starts
A defined but unloaded service is loaded and started instead of reported as already loaded
Stop waits until launchd has released the service before start
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no personal data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-23 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
